name: TOB Social Content
description: Hand-approved content for scheduled social posts, one row per post idea, grouped by Content Type (App Feature, Salvation Prayer, ...). The outreach VPS worker posts approved rows of a type on that type's schedule (TOB Blessing Automation Settings → Content Schedules), least recently posted first, as a designed card (title + image text + image footer) with the caption below. Never state anything untrue about the app, never fabricate testimonies, and quote Scripture exactly (KJV, with reference). Editing any post wording clears the approval.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Shown large on the image, e.g. 'Gospel Compare' or 'A Prayer of Salvation'.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: AI Draft = written by the app's AI from an admin's brief. Check it word for word before approving.

fields.label: Image Footer
fields.description: Small line at the bottom of the image, e.g. a Scripture reference 'Romans 10:9'. App features show a Google Play button instead.

fields.label: Where in the App
fields.description: App features only: breadcrumb added to the caption, e.g. 'Explore → Gospel Compare'.

fields.label: Image Text
fields.description: Shown under the title on the image: a one-line benefit for a feature, or the prayer itself (keep it under about 350 characters).

fields.label: Post Text
fields.description: The caption. The worker adds the app link and the type's hashtags after it.

fields.label: Checked & approved for social posts
fields.description: Tick only after checking every word: app features against the live app, prayers and Scripture quotations against a KJV Bible. Approved content may be posted automatically.
